title: Multi-runtime progressive output adapters and SDK examples (TS/Python/Go)
creator: Aisha Patel
acceptance_criteria: Canonical TypeScript, Python, and Go examples added to the SDK repo under examples/progressive-output
Compatibility shim provided that maps legacy onChunk/onDone invocations to the new iterator model
Unit and E2E tests validating event ordering, tool round-trip correctness, and schema-based structured_output handling
Documentation/migration guide published to docs.redwood.ai linking to code samples
Telemetry hooks and recommended defaults documented for Console/Observability teams
tasks: Write TypeScript adapter + legacyShim and unit tests
Write Python adapter + legacy_shim and unit tests
Write Go adapter + legacy shim example and integration test
Add end-to-end test harness against runtime staging for tool call flow
Draft migration guide and small section for Console on telemetry expectations
Open PRs for each SDK and coordinate reviews with DX/Docs teams
